nodes.title: SG-8.3.2 context.md stack and module paths tests pass
nodes.body:
Context: the repo-root context.md is still the old README-only text, so game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts fails. The helpers (contextModulePaths in lib/contextDoc.ts; STACK_TERMS, missingTerms, missingPaths, staleTextHits in lib/docsCheck.ts) already exist and are correct. Desired behaviour: context.md names the real stack, lists the real module paths and drops the stale text. Why: docs must match the code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the rewritten context.md, when missingTerms runs with STACK_TERMS, then it returns [].
- Given the module table, when contextModulePaths runs, then game/src/, game/frontend/src/, game/docs/GDD.md and backend/ are present and all exist on disk.
- Given context.md, when staleTextHits runs, then it returns [] and no 'Frameworks: UNKNOWN' line remains.
- All four tests in game/frontend/tests/contextDoc.test.ts pass and are reported as run.


## Scope
- In scope: Repo-root context.md content (stack, modules, entry points)
- Out of scope: Changing helpers or tests
- Out of scope: GDD feature index
- Out of scope: Gameplay or backend changes
- Preserve: Existing contextDoc tests, none deleted or skipped
- Preserve: Phaser pinned at ~3.90.0


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- No test is deleted or skipped
- No source file over 200 lines
- game/src never imports from game/frontend
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope; mention it only as out of scope


## Definition of done
- contextDoc.test.ts: 4 of 4 tests pass
- npm run typecheck passes in game/frontend


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.body:

## Acceptance criteria
- docsCheck.ts STACK_TERMS holds TypeScript, Phaser 3.90, React, Zustand, Radix, Vitest, the terms the rewritten context.md Stack must name.
- docsCheck.ts STALE_TEXT holds 'hello Worldseed', 'Traceability index' and the 'Executable / server / CLI `main` | UNKNOWN' row, none of which the rewritten context.md may contain.


## Scope
- In scope: docsCheck.ts STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT
- Out of scope: Tests, behaviour changes to helpers
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0
- Do not change helper behaviour
- Code path: `game/frontend/src/lib/docsCheck.ts`


## Dependencies
- R1


## Definition of done
- STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT confirmed unchanged and matching the spec
- No helper code change was needed


## Clarifying questions
- None
